list: The official 55 trophies, as published on PlayStation (via Exophase) and reported by Push Square, 18 November 2026. Names, descriptions and grades are the official ones; every guide below is written in our own words for this guide.

notes.online: There are no online trophies. All 55 can be earned solo and offline.
notes.missable: Only one trophy is reported as potentially missable: Positive Mental Attitude (a Chapter 1 meditation). Every other trophy can be earned in free-roam after the story.
notes.time: PowerPyx rates the set 4/10 and estimates about 200 hours to the platinum, in a single playthrough.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment you earn the other 54 trophies. Nothing here needs multiplayer or DLC: all 55 are single-player and offline. The long pole is A Long Road (100% completion), so treat the roadmap as the real plan — finish the story, work the 100% checklist, then clean up the side strands, collectibles and grinds. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and estimates about 200 hours.
steps: Finish the story (Chapters 1-5 and the final mission).
Complete the 100% Completion checklist for A Long Road.
Clean up the remaining side strands, collectibles and activities.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the other 54 are earned.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set and the second gold. After the story, the 100% Completion checklist appears under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion — and progress you made during the story already counts. The requirements are forgiving: it is closer to 60% true completion. You need any 70 of 80 challenges, any 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, any 100 of 255 animals studied, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations and 10 of 13 race-challenge gold medals. The only parts that demand everything are robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's target decks. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and it is all doable in free-roam after the story.
steps: Finish the story, then open Progress, Stats, 100% Completion.
Work the checklist: 100 optional missions, all robberies, all shooting ranges, all drone races, all 15 of Bret's target decks.
Fill the partial bars: 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles, 100 of 255 animals, 300 stunts, 15 of 18 meditations.
The gold trophy unlocks when the checklist hits 100%.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game, mixing the four types however you like: 130 stunt jumps over ramps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights between buildings and 25 base jumps. Under-the-bridge flights are the quickest to farm. Track your progress under Progress, Activities, Stunts, and find the spots on the map under Exploration, Stunt Spots — each one stays marked once completed. Note that 100% completion needs 300 stunts, so keep going past 250.
steps: Open the map, Exploration, Stunt Spots to see stunt locations.
Complete any 250 stunts across the four types (jumps, under bridges, knife flights, base jumps).
Under-the-bridge flights are the fastest to repeat.
The trophy pops at 250; 100% completion needs 300.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a car race / race challenge / Top Fun drone race, and performing a stunt. Check your progress under Touchpad, Progress, Activities, and find activity spots on the map with the blue dumbbell filter. You will do most of these automatically while working on the other trophies, so this usually pops on its own — if it has not, look at the Activities menu to see which type is still at zero.
steps: Open Touchpad, Progress, Activities to see which of the 9 types you still need.
Do one of each: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting range, pool, basketball, a video game, a race win, a stunt.
Activity spots are marked with blue icons on the map (Activities filter).
The trophy pops once all 9 types have been tried.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting range challenges, spread across 12 shooting range locations. The gold medals are not very hard, and shooting range practice also raises your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger. All 42 golds are required for 100% completion too, so this is not optional work — do the ranges as you find them and clean up the rest after the story.
steps: Find shooting ranges (12 locations) and open their challenges.
Earn a gold medal in each of the 42 challenges.
Ranges also raise Focus, which helps Gunslinger.
All 42 golds count toward 100% completion.

steps: Find race locations around Leonida (40 unique spots).
Win a race at 20 different locations.
Easier races first; race-challenge golds also count toward 100%.

steps: Play the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui to meet Cal.
Wait for Cal's text message marking a fishing spot (purple icon).
Follow his fishing questline to the challenge.
Beat Cal in the fishing challenge.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish all the levels of any one of the 4 arcade games (called Video Games in-game): Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind, playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1, or Bang For Your Buck, found on arcade machines around the world. You only need to reach the end of one game — you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game you like best and play it through.
steps: Play an arcade game: three are on the TV at home, Bang For Your Buck is on arcade machines.
Finish all levels of that game at least once.
You do not need to beat every in-game challenge.
The trophy pops when you reach the end of the game.

steps: In Chapter 3, play as Lucia until Andy calls and texts her address (Belville).
Complete the 5 Andy quests: Climbing the Cellerichain (1-3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label, Puff Puff Pass.
All quests stay available after the story.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's treasure-diving questline. It opens automatically in Chapter 1: a while after the mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton), he calls you and is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He marks purple treasure-chest icons on the map — dive to the shipwrecks, use the metal detector to dig the treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back to him. There are 7 shipwrecks in total. Track progress under Progress, Characters, Kenton Rees. Kenton is temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1 but returns in Chapters 2-3, so the questline is not missable.
steps: After the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams, wait for Kenton's call (green KR icon, Key Lento).
Dive to the marked shipwrecks and dig up treasures with the metal detector.
Bring each set back to Kenton; he marks the next set after each delivery.
Clear all 7 shipwrecks to finish his final mission.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Careful: not every optional questline counts. Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not count toward this trophy — the game only counts certain stranger strands. Confirmed to count are Kirk (the Skunk Ape quests), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, and more strangers are still being found. All of them remain available in free-roam after the story. Check your count in the trophy list's tracker as you go.
steps: Find Strangers & Freaks questlines in the open world (purple markers).
Complete full strands — confirmed counting ones include Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete.
Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie questlines do NOT count.
The trophy pops after your 8th completed strand.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's Wish List. It opens automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner for breaking into high-end sports cars. Randy then wants 16 sports cars delivered to his garage (green RK icon in the west of Vice City). Track the list under Map, Robberies, Randy's Wish List — he marks some cars in fixed locations, but you can also steal them off the street. Scan cars with the WAiNK app to check if one is on the list, and deliver in good condition for more pay. Sports cars are common in the east of Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. This can all be done after the story.
steps: Play the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to unlock the Key Cloner and Randy's Wish List.
Scan high-end sports cars with the WAiNK app to see if they are wanted.
Steal and deliver all 16 cars to Randy's garage (green RK icon, west Vice City).
Delivering in good condition pays more; the trophy pops after the last car.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across 10 locations. You can meditate with both Lucia and Jason at each spot, which counts as +2 meditations at the same location. Track progress under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations. THE MISSABLE ONE: there is a first meditation in Chapter 1 at Jason's house that becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. After the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow her and choose Accept. PowerPyx notes it is still unclear whether this one is required for the trophy, but its author had done it when the trophy popped, so do it to be safe. For 100% completion you only need 15 of 18 meditations, so this does not affect A Long Road.
trophies.missable_note: The Chapter 1 meditation at Jason's house is only available during Chapter 1. After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. It is still unconfirmed whether this one is required for the trophy — do it to be safe.
steps: CHAPTER 1 ONLY: after the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning.
Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept when she offers to show you meditation.
After Chapter 2 (Coffee Break) you can play as both characters and meditate at each spot twice (+2 per location).
Meditate at all 18 spots across the 10 locations; track under Progress, Collections, Exploration, Meditations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Complete Bret Vogel's hunting questline, which is exclusive to Jason. It opens after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break: while playing as Jason you get a text message from Bret that marks his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. After that he marks hunting spots with purple icons on the map — hunt the animals he requests and bring them to him. During the first quest he gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, retrievable from any weapon locker at Ammu-Nations. His quests are tracked under Map, Activities, Target Deck — there are 15 target decks, and all 15 are needed for 100% completion, so you will earn this naturally along the way. The questline stays available after the story.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, play as Jason and wait for Bret Vogel's text.
Meet Bret in Lummox County (quest: Veteran Hunted) and take the Killtelligence SM-69 rifle.
Hunt the animals Bret marks on the map and bring them to him.
The trophy unlocks when you hunt the unique animal he asks for.

steps: Collect cards across Leonida (18 sets, 480 cards total).
Complete all cards in any 3 sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app on your phone: hold Up to open it, then hold R1 to scan what you are looking at. There are more than 100 in total — 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and the No Flusher tags — so it does not matter which 100 you scan. Scan everything you pass while playing and this pops naturally; a dedicated sweep of landmarks and curiosities finishes it fast.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up), then hold R1 to scan objects.
Scan landmarks, curiosities, sculptures and No Flusher tags as you pass them.
Any 100 scans count — there are well over 100 in the world.
The trophy pops at the 100th scan.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete any 50 of the 80 challenges — there are 8 categories with 10 challenges each, and you only need 50, so skip the hardest ones. Track them under Progress, Challenges. Most will complete naturally while you work on the other trophies and the 100% checklist (which needs any 70 of 80), so leave this for late in the run and then pick the easiest remaining challenges to finish it off.
steps: Open Progress, Challenges to see the 80 challenges across 8 categories.
Complete any 50 — skip the hardest ones.
Most complete naturally while working on other trophies.
100% completion needs 70 of 80, so this pops on the way.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level and then escape it. This only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can free-roam as Jason and Lucia together — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Cause chaos until you hit 4 stars, then break away on a fast sports motorcycle and cut through traffic to leave the search area; the trophy pops once you drive out of the red heat zone. A reliable escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where cops and the helicopter struggle to follow. It also unlocks automatically during the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is, since bank vault robberies always trigger a 4-star wanted level.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Cause chaos until you reach a 4-star wanted level.
Escape on a fast sports motorcycle — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) works well.
The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob 3 shops in a row while keeping your wanted level the whole time. This only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when duo free-roam unlocks — call your partner by holding Right and pressing Triangle. Hit 3 robbery targets (green icons) back-to-back, staying in the flashing red/blue wanted state rather than letting it drop or escalating to the red heat level. Bring an armored vest, sticky bombs and healing items, and loot properly in each shop (including the back room and safe) so each robbery counts. A good spot is the 3 jewelry stores in the north of Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. The trophy pops about half a minute after leaving the third shop — if it does not, hit a fourth shop and keep going.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Stock up: armored vest, sticky bombs, healing items.
Rob 3 shops back-to-back (green icons) without losing your wanted level.
The trophy pops ~30 seconds after leaving the 3rd shop; if not, rob a 4th.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. The fastest way is the WAiNK app on your phone (hold Up to open it instantly), then look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning is enough, you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything passing by. There are 557 vehicles at launch (cars, bikes, boats, helicopters, planes), and 100% completion needs 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this pops naturally on the way. Check your totals under Touchpad, Progress, Vehicles.
steps: Open the WAiNK app (hold Up) and scan vehicles with R1.
Stand on a busy road and scan passing traffic.
Scanning is enough — you do not need to drive the vehicle.
The trophy pops at 100 discovered vehicles; 200 are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during one use of Combat Focus. Activate it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows and vulnerable spots on enemies are highlighted, but it drains the purple focus bar fast and only lasts a few seconds. Prepare first: buff your focus by eating, drinking or washing your face and showering at home, and consume Adrenaline to extend the focus time. Then line up 5 enemies — criminals at gang operations work well — and drop them quickly without missing, ideally with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556, wearing body armor so you can step out of cover. It does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels (check Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, Focus) and rises from shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so this gets easier late in the game.
steps: Buff Focus first: eat and drink, wash up at home, take Adrenaline.
Find 5 grouped enemies (criminals at a gang operation work well).
Aim and activate Combat Focus (L3 + R3), then drop all 5 in one use.
Use an accurate full-auto rifle and body armor; soldiers, police and civilians do not count.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal one of the large passenger planes docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — it must be a plane connected to a passenger boarding bridge, not one sitting on the airfield. The easiest is the plane at departure terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, head to the plane, and use the stairs next to the boarding bridge, where a door leads straight inside. Go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backward to the airstrip, take off and fly at least 1 km away from the airport — the trophy is slightly delayed and pops once you are far enough out. You can also walk in through the airport terminal on foot, but the airfield route is faster.
steps: Go to VCIA and find the large passenger plane docked at terminals E3/E4.
Enter through the stairs by the boarding bridge and reach the cockpit upstairs.
Drive the plane backward to the airstrip and take off.
Fly at least 1 km away from the airport; the trophy pops shortly after.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without setting off the alarm or being spotted. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs — it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently lockpicking alarmed doors and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons on the map. Enter through the back door using the Snap Gun (the gadget stays in your inventory; when you approach a locked door you get the choice to kick it, which triggers the alarm, or use the Snap Gun for the stealth approach). Inside, find the note with the safe code and loot the safe. A good location is Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun.
Go to a jewelry store (green icon), e.g. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City.
Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun — do not kick the door.
Find the safe code note inside, open the safe and loot it undetected.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 of the 8 large bank vaults and escape each time. First finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe), which is marked automatically from story progress and teaches you the method: tail a security van until it stops at a bank, wait for the guard to carry the briefcase in and open the vault, then slip in while it is open and rob it — bring your partner, since you cannot carry all the cash alone (hold Right to hand off a bag). After that quest you can pay Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000) once you have done his earlier quests, including robbing 2 Payday Loans. Robbing a vault instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and switch vehicles to become unrecognizable. All 8 vaults are needed for 100% completion, and one bank can pay up to $205,000 — the best endgame money in the game.
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is to unlock bank vault robberies.
Buy security-van tips from Yasmani ($10,000) or follow vans to banks yourself.
Tail a van, enter the vault while it is open, rob it with your partner carrying a bag.
Escape the 4-star wanted level; repeat for any 5 of the 8 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: This unlocks automatically in the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (Wait at the Cafe) — the same mission that opens bank vault robberies. You tail the armored truck to the bank, the guard carries the cash to the vault, and robbing the vault counts as robbing the armored truck; escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) to finish it. You can also get it earlier: armored trucks drive around Vice City near banks — block one, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open, then escape the heat radius. Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests, and Yasmani becomes a fence from the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is (marked automatically).
Tail the armored truck to the bank and rob the vault — this counts as the truck robbery.
Escape the red heat radius or use a Pay 'n' Spray.
Alternative: block a roaming armored truck, sticky-bomb its back door, then escape.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, one of the gang operations in Port Gellhorn. Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation first — you need them to blow the safe. The three items are: the luxury watch in the office in the south-east, the unique shotgun variant Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the office in the north-east hallway (blow it up with sticky bombs). You visit the bowling alley during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, which is marked automatically. The trophy unlocks after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item — and killing the enemies is not necessary. If you miss an item during the mission, the robbery icon respawns after a while, so you can go back and grab the rest later: this trophy is NOT missable.
steps: Buy sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation.
During the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling, go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn.
Take the 3 valuables: luxury watch (south-east office), Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun (north-east table), safe contents (north-east hallway, sticky bombs).
Escape the police; the trophy pops after the escape. Missed items can be grabbed later when the icon respawns.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have maximum strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. Check strength under Touchpad, Jason & Lucia, then select a character and scroll to Strength. This only becomes possible after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, when you can switch between both characters. Raise strength by working out — buy a membership at a fitness club (filter for them on the map under Activities) and always go together with both characters (hold Right and press Triangle to call your partner): while you actively work out with one character, the other completes their training automatically, so you make double progress. You can also work out at home after the story.
steps: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, buy a fitness club membership.
Always work out together: call your partner (hold Right + Triangle).
Train both characters to maximum strength — the partner trains automatically while you work out.
The trophy pops once both are at maximum strength at the same time.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Perform 500 actions that affect your criminal profile. You can see your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list. Turn on criminal profile notifications first (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile = On) — whenever you do something that affects your reputation, a small demon face appears on the right of the screen. The profile moves through Professional (stealthy objectives, clean escapes), Hardened (incapacitating without killing), Violent (killing enemies and civilians), Psycho (killing large numbers of cops and civilians, driving over gravestones) and Irredeemable — a permanent status from excessive violence, which makes cops more aggressive, so avoid it. This happens passively: every robbery and enemy encounter counts, so you will very likely get it naturally while working on the other trophies. If it is still missing at the end, it can be farmed quickly by running over civilians and cops with a car.
steps: Turn on criminal profile notifications (Settings, UI, HUD Notifications, Criminal Profile).
Play normally — robberies and enemy encounters all count toward the 500.
Check your count by clicking the trophy in the trophy list.
Avoid reaching Irredeemable (permanent); if short at the end, farm profile actions with a car.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder a total of $250,000 in marked bills through your contacts. First finish the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) — it unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer you need to launder marked bills. Then rob banks and Payday Loans and bring the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. The $250,000 counts across all robberies, so you do not need to bring it all at once. This comes naturally while doing robberies for 100% completion — a single bank vault can hold up to $205,000, though vaults only open after the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is.
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and Payday Loans for marked bills.
Bring the bills to a fence (Yasmani in Vice City pays the most).
The $250,000 total is cumulative across all robberies.

Fastest: guns at Ammu-Nation, car mods, tattoos.

Bank vault robberies fund it easily in the endgame.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses), and it lets you register stolen vehicles and have them delivered to your location. Each garage adds parking spots, so buy enough garages first (see Little Boxes). Then drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and, in his garage, choose Respray and then Register. At first he only accepts vehicles without trackers; later in Chapter 3 you can also register cars with standard trackers at any Pay 'n' Spray. Registering costs money, so use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep expenses down.
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to unlock the Scooter Bros app.
Buy garages first (Little Boxes) — each adds parking spots.
Drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn, choose Respray then Register.
Register 10 vehicles; cheap cars and bikes keep the cost down.
